title: Mavinakaayi Gojju
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

    boiled mavinakayi

    curd

    coriander leaves

    ginger

    green chilli

    salt

    how to prepare:
    In bowl add some boiled raw mango and smash it with hand then add some green chillies,
    curd and salt and mix it well and serve it with hot rice.
